steps.name: init-folders
steps.description: Create mandatory task folder structure (assets, corrections, intervention, logs, plan, research, results, code).

steps.name: research-papers
steps.description: Skipped: this is a corrective re-run of t0126 with two evaluator changes; no new literature evidence needed.

steps.name: research-internet
steps.description: Skipped: no external knowledge gap; signed-DSI formula is the textbook DS-RGC definition and is already implemented inline.

steps.name: research-code
steps.description: Review t0126's evaluator.py, nsga2_driver.py, run_seed*.sh wrapper, post-run analysis, and metrics builder so the fork is faithful.

steps.name: planning
steps.description: Write plan covering: evaluator fork, signed-DSI helper, per-cell rate fields, cell_params.jsonl persistence, seed 3517 run, post-run analysis vs t0126.

steps.name: setup-machines
steps.description: Provision a Vast.ai instance matching t0126's profile (~32 vCPU EPYC), so the t0129 NSGA-II run completes in the same ~9h envelope as t0126 and the cross-task comparison is apples-to-apples. UN-SKIPPED 2026-05-26 after the local 4-worker run was killed at ~7 min/cell (extrapolated 5-7 days for 60 gen).

steps.name: implementation
steps.description: Fork t0126 code into tasks/t0129/code/, apply signed-DSI + per-cell rate edits, persist cell_params.jsonl, run seed-3517 NSGA-II via run_seed3517.sh, compute Pareto + comparison to t0126.

steps.name: teardown
steps.description: Destroy the Vast.ai instance after NSGA-II completes and results have been downloaded; finalise costs.json and remote_machines_used.json. UN-SKIPPED 2026-05-26 alongside setup-machines.

steps.name: creative-thinking
steps.description: Skipped: scope is a tightly defined corrective re-run; alternative approaches belong in follow-up suggestions, not this task.

steps.name: results
steps.description: Write results_summary.md, results_detailed.md, metrics.json, costs.json, remote_machines_used.json; embed Pareto + DSI distribution + PD-vs-ND scatter + t0126 overlay charts.

steps.name: compare-literature
steps.description: Skipped: comparison target is t0126's own front (intra-project), not published literature; covered in results_detailed.md.

steps.name: suggestions
steps.description: Generate follow-up suggestions: multi-seed extension, signed-DSI re-analysis of t0124/t0117/t0116 cohorts, etc.

steps.name: reporting
steps.description: Run all verificators, capture sessions, mark task completed, push branch, open and merge PR.
